title: salvia verbenaca subsp. sabulicola
intro: Salvia verbenaca subsp. sabulicola, commonly known as a coastal clary sage, is a subspecies of the perennial herb Salvia verbenaca, native to the Mediterranean region. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving cognitive function. The therapeutic actions of Salvia verbenaca subsp. sabulicola are attributed to its ability to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and neuroprotective agent, which may help alleviate symptoms of anxiety and improve sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
